start: Online gym whose server keeps photos, Add member sheet open on a computer with a camera

steps.action: Look at the top of the form
user_sees: "Photo (optional)" with a "Take photo" button
Hint: "Helps staff recognise members at check-in. Only your gym’s staff can see it."
must_not: The photo row asked for as a needed step

steps.action: Tap "Take photo"
user_sees: The form is replaced by a sheet titled "Take photo"
"Starting the camera… If the browser asks, tap Allow." then the live picture
"Ask the member to look at the camera, with their face inside the oval."
must_not: The typed name and number lost when the form comes back
Two sheets on top of each other

steps.action: Tap "Take photo", check the picture, tap "Use photo"
user_sees: "Check that the face is clear. Tap Use photo to keep it."
Back on the form: a round picture, buttons "Change photo" and "Remove"
must_not: The picture flipped compared with the preview
The camera left on after the photo is taken

steps.action: Fill name and mobile, tap "Add member"
user_sees: "Saving…", then the member's page with the photo
must_not: The photo saved to another member
The member not saved because of the photo

start: Add member sheet open on a computer with no camera

steps.action: Tap "Take photo"
user_sees: "No camera was found on this computer. Tap Upload a photo to pick a picture instead."
Button "Upload a photo"
must_not: A blank black box with no words
The sheet closing by itself

steps.action: Tap "Upload a photo", pick a JPG, tap "Use photo"
user_sees: The picked picture, then the form with the round picture
must_not: A file that is not a picture accepted (wrong file: "That photo couldn’t be used. Pick a JPG or PNG picture.")

steps.action: Fill name and mobile, tap "Add member"
user_sees: The member's page with the photo
must_not: The full-size file stored instead of the small picture

start: Add member sheet open with a photo taken, name and mobile filled; the photo save then fails

steps.action: Tap "Add member" while the photo server cannot be reached
user_sees: The sheet stays open with a red banner: "{name} is added, but the photo was not saved. Open {name}’s page and tap Take photo to try again."
One button: "Close"
The photo row is gone
must_not: "Add member" still offered, so a second tap makes the member twice
The member not saved
A success with no word about the photo

steps.action: Tap "Close"
user_sees: The sheet closes and the new member's page opens, with initials in place of a photo
must_not: The member lost
An enquiry being converted left unlinked

start: Offline gym, the demo, or a gym whose server does not keep photos; Add member sheet open

steps.action: Look at the top of the form
user_sees: No "Photo (optional)" row; the form starts with Full name
must_not: A "Take photo" button that fails when pressed
An empty gap where the row would be

start: Add member sheet open; the browser's camera permission is refused

steps.action: Tap "Take photo"
user_sees: "The camera is blocked. Tap the camera or lock icon next to the web address, choose Allow, then reload the page. Or tap Upload a photo."
must_not: A permission prompt on every tap
The form's typed values lost when the camera sheet is closed

start: Add member sheet open with a photo already taken

steps.action: Tap "Change photo", take another, tap "Use photo"
user_sees: Sheet titled "Change photo"; then the form shows the new picture
must_not: The first picture kept

steps.action: Tap "Remove"
user_sees: The round picture goes; the button reads "Take photo" again
must_not: The removed picture still sent on save

steps.action: Fill name and mobile, tap "Add member"
user_sees: The member's page with initials, no photo
must_not: A photo saved for the member

start: Add member sheet open, camera sheet open

steps.action: Read the lines under the photo row and in the camera sheet
user_sees: "Helps staff recognise members at check-in. Only your gym’s staff can see it."
"Only your gym’s staff can see this photo. It shows on the member’s page, their member card and at check-in."
must_not: The photo visible to another gym, to other members, or on a public page
The photo kept after "Cancel" on the form (it must exist only in this browser until the member is saved)
